name: pulsecast
description: 怦然 PulseCast · 主播心率直播伴侣（Tauri 前端 + 本地服务）

scripts.serve:mobile: node -e "const http=require('http'),fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');const r=http.createServer((q,s)=>{let f=q.url.split('?')[0];if(f==='/')f='/mobile/index.html';const fp=p.join(__dirname,f);fs.readFile(fp,(e,d)=>{if(e){s.statusCode=404;s.end('not found');return;}const ext=p.extname(fp);s.setHeader('Content-Type',ext==='.html'?'text/html':ext==='.css'?'text/css':ext==='.js'?'text/javascript':'text/plain');s.end(d);});});r.listen(4568,()=>console.log('mobile preview on http://localhost:4568'));"
